meta.title: QQBot SkillPack
meta.description: QQ 机器人功能整合包：Steam 监控、课表提醒、VJudge 赛况/题单进度、免@聊天、闭嘴开关、身份标识、分条发送。为每个功能提供独立开关，适配 DeepSeek Harness。

steam.desc: Monitor specified Steam accounts for online/play/quit/new library/wishlist discounts, query game library and achievements, render images.
classReminder.desc: Remind classmates N minutes before class, supports multi-timezone, teaching week, holidays.
vjudgeContest.desc: Monitor VJudge contest Rank changes, summarize AC/WA/new participants, manual rank query, auto-stop after contest ends.
vjudgeProgress.desc: Dark neon leaderboard image, completed/quit lists, diff vs last query.
freechat.desc: Auto-reply in specified groups without @, cooldown + probability control, mention boosts probability.
shutup.desc: @bot 闭嘴 → 10 min no-auto-reply, true @ directed QA not affected.
enabled.desc: Enable or disable the whole QQBot SkillPack plugin.
autoAdapt.enabled.desc: Enable to auto-detect and bind QQ robot workspace
